messages.content: What was your first instructor like when something went wrong?
I didn't always have an instructor. Sometimes a tool slipped and a knee received a lesson. Other times a teacher had to admit that they had been thinking. It took a while to discover which was which.
Do the two of you still meet?
No. I left the monastery. We still help each other with repairs when we are in the valley.
